message: Vector Rebel 3.2.51 handles singular Structural Boot PPE titles and keeps one-owner selection correction.
releaseNotes: Rebel Command evidence identified a Structural Boot listed as BALDREE-5633595-BB... but displayed as Structural Boot: BALDREE-5633595-BB with matching serial. Read-only PPE identity recovery now accepts the official singular Structural Boot heading as well as Boots, while requiring the exact item route, serial, type, and full-name identity verification. Includes 3.2.50 strict one-Responsible-Party selection.
